spans.s: The twenty-second consonant of the Nāgarī Alphabet, the aspirate of the preceding letter, and expressed by Ph.

m. (फः)
1 Increasing, swelling, enlarging, expanding.
2 Performance of a mystical rite, by which KUVERA'S attendants are propitiated.
3 A high wind, a gale.
4 Wind expelled in yawning.
5 Fruitfulness, fertility.
6 An augmentor or increaser.
nf. (फं फा)
Unprofitable or idle speech.
n. (फं)
1 Angry speech.
2 Bursting with some little noise, as air bubbles, boiling water, &c.; bubbling, boiling.
f. (फा)
Distress, anxiety.
E.
फल to bear fruit, or स्फाय to swell, aff. ड; in the latter case, the initial is rejected.
